exposure_source: BMD GWAS, European, UK Biobank + FinnGen (n=326,885; details in Table S2, not accessed)
outcome_source: Endometriosis GWAS (source listed in Table S2, not accessed)
instruments_location: Table S3 (instruments), Table S5 (estimates); supplementary xlsx not downloaded
notes: Proxy for raloxifene/colecalciferol (ESR1 activators): BMD-associated variants (FDR<0.05) within +/-2.5 kb of ESR1, clumped (r2<0.01 Results; r2<0.001 Methods). OR per unit genetically proxied BMD via ESR1; scaling presumably BMD-raising (agonist proxy), not stated. Endometriosis estimate appears only in Fig 3 (p=3.6e-02); Results text lists six other autoimmune outcomes. 11 anti-osteoporosis targets screened against osteoporosis; only ESR1 carried forward. 134 SNPs within a +/-2.5 kb window of a ~470 kb gene; no multiple-testing correction across 11 outcomes.

exposure_source: Lipid-trait GWAS used to weight target variants (not stated in abstract)
outcome_source: Endometriosis stages 1-2 GWAS (source not stated in abstract)
notes: Abstract only (ScienceDirect and RBMO pages returned 403; no PMC copy). 'Genetic mimicry in PCSK9' OR for endometriosis stages 1-2; abstract gives no P, lipid trait used for weighting, outcome GWAS, or whether the exposure is scaled as lipid-lowering or raising. Conclusion favours lipid-lowering drugs, suggesting OR per unit higher lipid via PCSK9 variants (direction must be verified in full text). Abstract says SMR and colocalisation were run for significant targets; results not given. Overall-endometriosis estimate not in abstract.

instruments_location: Not listed in main text; supplementary tables (links.lww.com/MD/P28) not downloaded
replication_details: Asian endometriosis GWAS (Chou 2021 Sci Rep, 21,059 individuals): text reports 'similar outcomes'; estimates in Table S2, not extracted.
notes: 9 cathepsins tested; only cathepsin H significant at P<0.05 (no multiple-testing correction). Exposure SNPs P<5e-6, r2<0.001, PhenoScanner and MR-PRESSO filtering. FinnGen R9 subtypes: ovary OR 1.022 P=.046, pelvic peritoneum 1.046 P=.047, deep 1.050 P=.048. MVMR adjusted OR 1.034 P=.049. Reverse MR: endometriosis -> CTSH OR 1.017 P=.041. Preprint rs-3756621 (2023) is the same study with identical abstract estimates.

PCSK9-inhibitor proxy: LDL-C-associated variants within +/-100 kb of PCSK9 (r2<0.3); exposure defined as LDL-lowering (inhibition); unit not stated (ieu-a-300 is SD units). Abstract misprints OR as 0.971 (0.688-0.909); Figure 2 gives p<0.001. Repeated with alternative LDL-C exposure GWAS ieu-b-5089: 'similar conclusions' (Table S4). After removing pleiotropic SNPs text gives 'OR=0.97, 95% CI 0.69-0.91' (misprint). CHD positive control passed. HMGCR null for endometriosis (OR 0.9746, P=0.849).

exposure_source: Plasma ADAMTS13 level GWAS (Ma 2017, Blood Adv)
replication_details: FinnGen finn-b-N14_ENDOMETRIOSIS (8288/68,969): IVW OR 0.46 (0.30-0.71), P=5.31e-4; author UKB+FinnGen meta: OR 0.42 (0.30-0.58), P=2.85e-7 (not independent).
source_location: Figure 2A; Results; Additional file 1 Table S2
notes: 11 coagulation traits tested; Bonferroni-significant (Padj=1.38e-3). Instruments P<5e-7, clumped r2<0.1 within 10 Mb, not restricted to the ADAMTS13 locus. Eligible under protein rule (c): proposed as therapeutic target. Pan-UKBB counts equal the PROTOCOL Pan-UKBB replication candidate (overlap). FinnGen estimate heterogeneous (random-effects P=0.056). FinnGen subtypes: ovary 0.48, pelvic peritoneum 0.32, uterus 0.45.

exposure_source: Plasma vWF level GWAS (Sabater-Lleal 2019, CHARGE trans-ethnic meta)
outcome_source: Author METAL meta-analysis of Pan-UK Biobank endometriosis (4354/217,500) and FinnGen finn-b-N14_ENDOMETRIOSIS (8288/68,969)
source_location: Figure 3; Results; Additional file 1 Table S6
notes: Meta-analysis used as the claim because vWF was null in the UKB discovery (OR 1.24, 0.97-1.58, P=0.082, Fig 2A) and FinnGen alone (OR 1.28, 1.06-1.53, P=0.009) did not survive the paper's multiple-testing correction; the paper's vWF conclusion rests on FinnGen plus the meta. Instruments P<5e-7, r2<0.1/10 Mb, genome-wide. FinnGen subtypes: ovary 1.34, pelvic peritoneum 1.48.

source_location: Results (TG-lowering drug targets); Fig 4; S5 Table; Abstract
notes: OR per 1 mmol/l higher TG proxied by variants within +/-100 kb of ANGPTL3 (P<5e-8, r2<0.3); exposure defined as TG-raising, so paper reads it as ANGPTL3 agonism protective (inhibitors not supported). PFDR=0.04; called 'suggestive' because coloc PP.H4=0.85% (recorded 0.0085). LPL, PPARA, APOC3 null. Drug-target MR run only in the EUR discovery outcome; no replication. Outcome is the non-23andMe European meta.

Framed as drug-target MR of UGCG inhibition (eliglustat; paper also lists migalastat). Exposure defined as lowering: paper inverts the expression OR, so higher UGCG expression -> higher risk. cis-eQTLs within 300 kb, P<1e-5, r2<0.3/100 kb, MAF>0.01, PhenoScanner and MR-PRESSO filtering. Release not stated; counts match FinnGen R10. Immune-cell mediation: 8 of 731 traits.
